summary:
H.J. Res. 109 is a Congressional Review Act joint resolution of disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, directed at the Securities and Exchange Commission’s “Staff Accounting Bulletin No. 121,” published at 87 Fed. Reg. 21015 on April 11, 2022. The resolution identifies the covered agency action by reference to that Federal Register publication and to the Government Accountability Office’s October 31, 2023 opinion, printed in the Congressional Record on November 1, 2023, at pages S5310–S5312, concluding that Staff Accounting Bulletin No. 121 is a “rule” for purposes of chapter 8 of title 5.

The sole operative provision provides that Congress disapproves the SEC rule relating to Staff Accounting Bulletin No. 121 and that “such rule shall have no force or effect.” The resolution does not amend any provision of the United States Code, establish a new program, confer new regulatory authority, impose reporting requirements, authorize appropriations, or make appropriations. Its operative mechanism is statutory disapproval pursuant to the Congressional Review Act; if enacted in the form prescribed for such resolutions, the identified SEC rule would be nullified in accordance with chapter 8 of title 5.

The text contains no express exceptions, savings clauses, transition rules, delayed effective date, implementation deadline, or conditions precedent other than enactment of the joint resolution through the constitutional legislative process.
